title: Align dataset evidence seam helper and audit error taxonomy
verify: Focused source-owner wiring tests prove an injected governance AUDIT_FAILED returns PHOTO_DATASET_AUDIT_FAILED / OPERATION_DATASET_AUDIT_FAILED with the same rollback and artifact cleanup that the baseline tests assert under the old generic codes, and TASK_AUDIT_FAILED remains unchanged.

The four source owners invoke the same generalized dataset-evidence helper (parameterized by source_kind/source_ref) as the single RecordDatasetEvidenceCommandV1 construction point; photo and task_follow_up no longer hard-code their source kind.
Independent Reviewer runs /verify and task-level /red-verify; contract rows exist in photo-intake-http.md and plant-operations-http.md before the code change.

verify.summary: 13/13 probes: photo/check-in/measurement governance audit failure returns new audit codes with zero rows/artifacts/candidates and identical rollback; generic persistence preserved; success path single candidate; rerun gates wiring 46, candidates 25, API 30, full deterministic 754/0, mb-lint 0, diff_check 0; spec-first order proven by mtimes; single RecordDatasetEvidenceCommandV1 site in evidence_seam.py:44, all four owners call shared helper; TASK_AUDIT_FAILED untouched; LOW note only.

purpose: Remove the repeated source-owner dataset-evidence seam wrapper and the divergent audit-failure taxonomy so one generalized helper serves all four Dataset Evidence Creation owners and a governance audit failure surfaces an explicit audit code on the photo/check-in/measurement paths, matching the TASK_AUDIT_FAILED precedent.
success_outcome: One shared generalized dataset-evidence helper (parameterized by source_kind/source_ref, the plant_operations shape) is the single seam invocation used by Photo Intake, Plant Operations (daily check-in and manual measurement), and Task & Follow-Up (follow-up outcome). PHOTO_DATASET_AUDIT_FAILED and OPERATION_DATASET_AUDIT_FAILED (HTTP 500) are added to the photo/plant error enums, the API route error tables, and the two HTTP contracts, and are raised only when DatasetGovernanceErrorCode.AUDIT_FAILED crosses the owner boundary; TASK_AUDIT_FAILED behavior is unchanged.
anti_goals: No change to Dataset Governance runtime, DatasetAgentRuntimeOutcomeV1, the migration chain, feature lifecycle/queue state, or any other module error contract.
No new HTTP/UI surface or response shape; both new codes reuse the existing HTTP 500 error envelope.
No change to non-audit error mapping, TASK_AUDIT_FAILED, or the accepted candidate-creation outcomes (same-UoW rollback, idempotency, unchanged source rows).
evidence_required: W2-F2-audit-code RED: before this task a DatasetGovernanceError(AUDIT_FAILED) raised by the creation seam during photo accept / daily check-in / manual measurement is collapsed by the owner services into generic PHOTO_PERSISTENCE_FAILED / OPERATION_PERSISTENCE_FAILED (baseline tests/backend/dataset_governance/test_{photo,check_in,measurement}_wiring.py assert those codes); GREEN: the same injected audit failure returns PHOTO_DATASET_AUDIT_FAILED / OPERATION_DATASET_AUDIT_FAILED with identical source-row and artifact rollback; decisive comparison: raised error code and row/artifact counts before vs after; artifact: focused wiring transcript under .tasks/TASK-059-T2-FT-014-W6/.

W2-F2-taxonomy RED: task_follow_up already maps governance AUDIT_FAILED to TASK_AUDIT_FAILED (task_follow_up/service.py:799-807) while photo/plant collapse it, so the same underlying failure is observable as an audit failure only on the outcome path; GREEN: all four source owners report the dataset-audit failure through their explicit audit code with TASK_AUDIT_FAILED unchanged; decisive comparison: per-owner raised code on the same injected failure; artifact: outcome-wiring transcript.

Seam-helper GREEN: photo and task_follow_up call the same generalized helper (parameterized by source_kind/source_ref) that plant_operations already uses, so one seam invocation shape serves all four source owners; decisive comparison: one shared construction site for RecordDatasetEvidenceCommandV1 per owner; artifact: static/scan evidence plus focused owner suite transcripts.

Contract GREEN: .memory-bank/contracts/photo-intake-http.md and .memory-bank/contracts/plant-operations-http.md register PHOTO_DATASET_AUDIT_FAILED / OPERATION_DATASET_AUDIT_FAILED (HTTP 500, Status/Error/Meaning rows) before the code change, and backend/app/api/photos.py / backend/app/api/operations.py map both codes to HTTP 500; decisive comparison: contract rows plus API error-table entries present; artifact: spec rows and API mapping snippet.
constraints: Spec-first: register the two new error codes in the two HTTP contracts (Status/Error/Meaning rows) BEFORE any code change; no other spec change.

Use the TASK_AUDIT_FAILED mapping as the taxonomy precedent: map only DatasetGovernanceErrorCode.AUDIT_FAILED to the new audit codes; every other governance error keeps the existing generic persistence mapping.

The shared helper receives the owner's bound injectable dataset_governance service and keeps same-UoW semantics; exact shared location is an immaterial executor choice inside the write boundary (expected backend/app/dataset_governance/evidence_seam.py).
Both new codes map to HTTP 500 through the existing route error tables; no new response shape or status is introduced.
Do not change TASK_AUDIT_FAILED behavior, task_follow_up audit semantics, or the acceptance outcomes of the four creation seams.
invariants: All four Dataset Evidence Creation source owners use the same seam invocation shape.

A governance audit failure is always an explicit audit failure on the owner boundary (TASK_AUDIT_FAILED / PHOTO_DATASET_AUDIT_FAILED / OPERATION_DATASET_AUDIT_FAILED), never a generic persistence failure.
Owner audit-failure rollback/cleanup semantics and the accepted candidate-creation outcomes remain unchanged.
verification_targets: Contract rows for the two new codes exist in photo-intake-http.md / plant-operations-http.md before the code change; API error tables map both new codes to HTTP 500.

forbidden_scope: Dataset Governance runtime, DatasetAgentRuntimeOutcomeV1, runtime_contracts.py, migrations, and other modules' error codes/contracts
TASK_AUDIT_FAILED behavior or task_follow_up audit semantics (already aligned)
Feature lifecycle/queue state and any spec change beyond the two HTTP contracts
stop_conditions: The shared helper cannot live in one shared location without a new unaccepted cross-module dependency or architecture change.
Registering the new codes requires a migration, a new response shape, a non-500 status, or a contract change beyond the two named rows.
Aligning the taxonomy requires changing TASK_AUDIT_FAILED behavior.
A governance audit failure no longer rolls back the source row/artifacts exactly as today.
The full deterministic suite cannot be green.
